boards.title: Your First Weekend at California Lutheran University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A Friday-to-Saturday sequence connecting current orientation touchpoints, campus landmarks, student spaces, dining, art, recreation and documented Cal Lutheran traditions.

cards.title: Start at Kingsmen Park
cards.subtitle: Friday morning · orientation check-in
cards.notes: Bring your remaining clearance information and collect your student ID, room key, orientation materials and weekend schedule before moving on.
cards.short_summary: Use the orientation hub to get your essential first-weekend materials in one stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran's current 2026 orientation schedule places residential and commuter student check-in at Kingsmen Park, where students receive IDs, keys, materials and schedules.
cards.access_notes: The cited schedule lists residential check-in from 8–10 a.m. and commuter check-in from 9–10 a.m. on August 21, 2026.

cards.title: Find Enormous Luther
cards.subtitle: Friday morning · campus-tour meeting point
cards.notes: Meet your Peer Adviser at the statue, then use the guided walk to locate classrooms and ask practical navigation questions before classes begin.
cards.short_summary: Turn a recognizable campus landmark into the starting point for learning your routes.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran's 2026 orientation schedule names Enormous Luther at Falde Plaza as the meeting location for Peer Adviser-led campus tours.
cards.access_notes: The guided orientation tour is scheduled from 10 a.m. to noon on August 21, 2026; participation is tied to orientation programming.

cards.title: Locate Pearson Library
cards.subtitle: Friday midday · academic home base
cards.notes: Enter behind Falde Plaza, learn where the circulation desk is and identify a study area you can return to once coursework starts.
cards.short_summary: Get acquainted with the main-campus library while nearby landmarks are still fresh.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran identifies Pearson Library on its Thousand Oaks campus, with its main entrance behind Falde Plaza and Enormous Luther; enrolled students have full library access.
cards.access_notes: Bring a Cal Lutheran-issued ID card for building and service access; visitors without an ID must sign in at the circulation desk.

cards.title: Pause at Ullman Dining
cards.subtitle: Friday lunch · learn the dining setup
cards.notes: Walk through the available stations, note options that fit your dietary needs and learn how your meal plan works before the weekday rush.
cards.short_summary: Use the first campus meal to understand the all-you-care-to-eat dining layout.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran describes Ullman Dining as an all-you-care-to-eat location with Mongolian grill, pizza, salad, fruit, deli, grill, pasta and bakery stations.
cards.access_notes: The university says campus dining locations accept meal-plan swipes; check the linked dining-hours service before visiting.

cards.title: Step Inside Samuelson Chapel
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · orientation gathering place
cards.notes: Mark the chapel on your mental map and use the scheduled session to understand how the university frames its Lutheran liberal-arts education.
cards.short_summary: Connect a central campus building with one of orientation's academic conversations.
cards.evidence_claim: The current 2026 orientation schedule places the session on Lutheran liberal-arts education and the Residence Life and Student Life family meeting in Samuelson Chapel.
cards.access_notes: Access during orientation follows the published event schedule; the cited page lists sessions at 1:30 p.m. and 2:15 p.m. on August 21, 2026.

cards.title: Reset at the Student Union
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · questions, games and downtime
cards.notes: Find the Info Desk, look over the games and equipment options, and save this central location as a reliable place for future campus questions.
cards.short_summary: Learn where to relax and seek practical help between scheduled activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran describes the Student Union as a central gathering place with an Info Desk, games, equipment rentals, workstations and student services.
cards.access_notes: The Student Union is at 3391 Mountclef Boulevard; consult its current hours link before arriving outside orientation programming.

cards.title: Learn the Gilbert Center
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · recreation orientation
cards.notes: Locate the fitness entrance, then complete the required waiver and keep your current student ID ready before planning a later workout.
cards.short_summary: Handle the access basics for a campus recreation facility you may use throughout the term.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran states that Forrest Fitness Center is inside Gilbert Sports and Fitness Center and is available to students with a current ID and completed liability waiver.
cards.source_title: Student Life - Undergraduate | California Lutheran University Catalog
cards.access_notes: Student entry requires a current student ID and completed online liability waiver; athletic facilities are available only during specified hours.

cards.title: Join the Mt. Clef Ridge Hike
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Paint the Rocks tradition
cards.notes: Wear suitable walking shoes, stay with the organized orientation group and bring water for the documented class hike and photo.
cards.short_summary: Take part in a school-specific ridge tradition with classmates and student leaders.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran documents Paint the Rocks as one of its oldest traditions and schedules new students to hike Mt. Clef Ridge, learn about class identity and take an official class photo.
cards.source_title: First-Year Students Schedule of Events | New Student Orientation
cards.access_notes: Join only through the organized orientation activity and follow university directions; the 2026 schedule lists the hike from 9:30–11 a.m.

cards.title: Browse the Rolland Art Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · student art stop
cards.notes: Check the exhibition schedule first, then spend a short visit with the student work displayed in the entrance gallery before evening events.
cards.short_summary: Add a visual-arts pause to the weekend without leaving the main campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran identifies the William Rolland Art Center as a modern visual-arts space displaying student work and states that its galleries charge no admission fees.
cards.source_title: Visit | Galleries & Exhibitions at Cal Lutheran
cards.access_notes: The Art Center is at 3350 Campus Drive. Check the exhibition schedule because galleries may close between installations.

cards.title: Finish at William Rolland Stadium
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · Playfair activities
cards.notes: Meet your assigned orientation group in the stadium and follow the facilitators through the organized games designed for new classmates.
cards.short_summary: Close the sequence with a structured, school-documented social activity for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Lutheran's current first-year orientation schedule places Playfair at William Rolland Stadium and describes it as a tradition featuring interactive games and activities with classmates and student leaders.
cards.source_title: First-Year Students Schedule of Events | New Student Orientation
cards.access_notes: Playfair is an organized orientation event; the 2026 first-year schedule lists it from 7:15–9 p.m. Follow the assigned orientation itinerary.
